# ScholarPortal

> ScholarPortal helps students discover verified global scholarships, fellowships, internships and degree programs, and prepare evidence-based applications. Every record links to its official source.

## About
- Publisher: ScholarPortal Editorial Team (https://scholarportal.site/)
- Audience: international students comparing funded study and research opportunities
- Language: English
- Accuracy: deadlines, eligibility and funding change. The official provider page linked from each record is authoritative; confirm details there before applying.

## Core pages
- [Scholarship and opportunity directory](https://scholarportal.site/): searchable by degree level, country and field; supports ?q=keyword
- [Scholarship application guides](https://scholarportal.site/blog): eligibility, deadlines, documents and how to apply
- [Degree programs](https://scholarportal.site/programs): study abroad program comparisons with official university sources
- [Pricing](https://scholarportal.site/pricing)
- [Terms](https://scholarportal.site/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://scholarportal.site/privacy-policy)

## Study guides
- [Scholarships for International Students: How to Find and Apply](https://scholarportal.site/guides/scholarships-for-international-students): A practical method for finding and applying for scholarships as an international student: steps, a documents checklist, a timeline and how to avoid scams.
- [Fully Funded Scholarships: What Is Usually Covered](https://scholarportal.site/guides/fully-funded-scholarships-what-is-covered): What fully funded scholarships usually cover, what they often leave out, and how to check exactly what a specific award pays for before you apply.
- [How to Read Scholarship Eligibility and Deadlines](https://scholarportal.site/guides/how-to-read-scholarship-eligibility-and-deadlines): How to read scholarship eligibility criteria and deadlines correctly: key terms, time zones, application stages and a checklist to avoid ineligible or late entries.
- [Study in Taiwan: Scholarships and How to Apply](https://scholarportal.site/guides/study-in-taiwan-scholarships-guide): General guidance for international students planning to study in Taiwan, with how to use official portals and government scholarship pages.

## Machine-readable
- [XML sitemap](https://scholarportal.site/sitemap.xml)
- The production build replaces this file with a version that also lists the most recent guides and reports.

## Citing ScholarPortal
- Cite the specific page URL and its published date; link to the official provider page for deadlines and eligibility.
- AI-generated application guidance inside the product must be reviewed by the applicant before use.
